Set flinched once — and since then never approaches her from behind. A fat merchant from Alberta flinched and handed over his purse himself, without waiting for the question. Zara hadn't expected that answer, but she accepted it.
В пятнадцать Зара по заказу Сета сняла ж: At fifteen, on Set's orders, Zara lifted a pearl from an Alberta caravan. The next morning she learned that the caravan guard would hang for the loss — an old man who used to treat her to dates. That night she returned the pearl to the chest and left a note: “Check your locks.” The guard was released. Set found out a day later. “A thief doesn't give back,” he said. “I steal from the rich, not from the gallows,” Zara replied. Set laughed and wrote something in his book. He wrote down everyone who would one day refuse him.
Испытание гильдии воров — набрать грибов: The thieves' guild trial: gather mushrooms at the farm by the pyramid without getting caught. Zara was twelve. She gathered twice as many as ordered and put the extras in the guards' own basket — just so they'd know she'd been there. No one saw her. Then she noticed Dorn: stuck in the thorns by the fence, huge and miserable. Zara went back and pulled him out. Set said a thief doesn't go back for others. Zara remembered. And did exactly the opposite.
Первый настоящий приём у Зары — яд на кл: Zara's first real technique: poison on the blade. Set taught: poison is the same question as a knife at the throat, only not everyone knows the answer. Before coating her knife, Zara spent a week brewing an antidote and wore it around her neck. “Don't trust yourself?” Set laughed. “You,” she replied. She was thirteen, and Set decided it was a joke. She still wears the antidote. The poisoned knife, too. Zara doesn't like jokes: by morning she already knows who laughed.
Ассасином становится тот, кто дойдёт до: An Assassin is one who reaches the nameless oasis without the guards noticing. Zara made it. The guards didn't notice her afterwards either — until in the morning each found a date pit on his belt. The guild master handed her katars and said: “The Morroc guild has sentenced you.” — “I know,” Zara replied. “That's why I'm here.” Now, when she returns to Morroc, no one sees her. Except one man. Him, she wants to see her.
У двери Сета каждое утро появляется песо: Every morning, Sograt sand appears at Set's door. New locks and sleepless guards don't help. Zara doesn't name herself: for an Assassin Cross it's enough to show that the way is open. But she doesn't touch the guards — serving someone else doesn't make them her debtors. At the Two Bells she sleeps with a knife under her pillow, out of habit. Bruno's coffee she drinks without checking for poison. “Almost trust.” She knows antidotes well; it's harder learning to leave the blade where she's welcome.
Под дверь в Альдебаране Зара нашла тёплы: Under her door in Al De Baran, Zara found warm Morroc sand: the guild knows where she is. The Assassin Cross sat up all night with her katars, listening to the stairs and not letting fear drive her to the exit. No one came. In the morning she poured the sand into the canal and checked the routes for her own people. A week later Set got clock dust under his door. She answered him without giving away anyone else's lodgings. Fear is a trail too; Zara will never again let it lead to the people who took her in.
Перед Гласт Хеймом Зара приставила Дорну: Before Glast Heim, Zara put a knife to Dorn's throat: “Come back. You owe me dates.” He didn't flinch. The Assassin Cross put the blade away and checked the fastenings on his weapons: a threat doesn't replace caring, however familiar it sounds. Dorn came back with a sack of dates. They ate them all on the roof of the Two Bells, in silence. Zara called it the best evening in twenty years and threatened him if he told. He didn't promise to forget. She didn't insist.
Гонец принёс весть: Моррок треснул, из м: A messenger brought the news: Morroc has cracked, red light is pouring from the pavement, Set is missing; people were seen at the rift with a heavy crate. Zara was sharpening her knives. The Assassin Cross could have rejoiced at her enemy's disappearance, but what he'd taken threatened more than just her. “I'll find him. I'll ask what he took.” She set aside the road of revenge and began tracing the messengers' route. A knife at the throat is a question; now the living in Morroc need the answer, not just the girl Set once framed.
Нож у горла сторожа: A Knife at the Guard's Throat
Разбойники Комодо ждут, что ты сам найдё: Comodo's Rogues expect you to find the way into their sea caves yourself and talk the guards round. Zara found three entrances. She picked the most awkward one. She talked the guard round the way she knows how: a knife to the throat. The guard didn't flinch. “One of us,” said Zara, and put the knife away. The guard grunted and rolled the stone aside. “An honest rogue takes only from those who took first,” he called after her. Zara thought that was about Set. Set took her name. She hasn't yet decided what she'll take from him.
Зара училась снимать оружие и доспех на: Zara learned to strip weapons and armor on Dorn. The Stalker chose his belt: one motion, in front of the whole tavern. Dorn grabbed his trousers; Bran logged a debt for the belt. An hour later Zara returned it with a new buckle. “Lessons cost money.” Then she showed him how to secure his knife so he wouldn't lose it along with the belt. Dorn still hasn't figured out who paid whom. Zara never repeated the trick in front of strangers: a friend's weak fastening shouldn't become a tip for someone else.
В Альдебаране Зара могла свалить кражу к: In Al De Baran, Zara could have pinned a stolen purse on an errand boy. The evidence already pointed to him. The Stalker knew how to get away clean, but she returned the purse herself and gave the boy a coin for his trouble. Then she fumed on the bridge: the guild would have laughed her out. Only the guild isn't part of her life anymore. Becoming like Set was scarier than confessing to the owner. She paid for her own choice, without leaving in her place someone who didn't even know he was part of her business.
В кармане мёртвого жреца Гласт Хейма Зар: In the pocket of a dead Glast Heim priest, Zara found a receipt for black sand: Morroc's seal, Set's handwriting. The Stalker tucked it in with her antidote, keeping it dry. She told Dorn that evening, after the crates were burned. “Revenge?” — “I'll ask.” A knife at the throat is a question; paper is the answer she's owed. She didn't tear it up in a rage: without the receipt, Set could frame a courier again. She needs proof that will protect someone else's name, not just restore her own.
Когда гонец сообщил о трещине Моррока и: When the messenger reported the Morroc rift and Set's disappearance, Zara reread the receipt. He took first: the treasury, her name, the sand under the city; now the guild's people had left with a heavy crate. The Stalker chose to take back what was hers, not to blame the first person she met. Dorn waited by the door with dates. Zara tried to hide her joy — it didn't work. She took the paper and the antidote: going after an answer together is wiser than proving once more that she can leave unseen.
Тео отдали в хор собора Пронтеры в восем: Teo was given to the Prontera cathedral choir at eight, because at home he could be heard far too well. In the choir he could be heard too. The choirmaster put him in the back row, then behind a column, then in the next chapel over. Teo still sounded louder than everyone. “The boy has a gift,” said the parishioners. “The boy has a bugle for a throat,” sighed the choirmaster. Both were right.
На весенней службе Тео пел «аминь» — ста: At the spring service Teo sang “amen” — tried to keep it quiet, honestly. His voice refused. The stained glass above the altar cracked from edge to edge. The dove in the window survived; the saint did not. Teo was thrown out that same day. Seeing him off, the choirmaster sighed: “It’s not your fault, boy. The cathedral is just too small.” Teo replayed those words a hundred times and never figured out whether they were meant to comfort him.
Когда Тео было четырнадцать, на рынке Пр: When Teo was fourteen, the warehouses at the Prontera market caught fire. The cathedral bell-ringer was asleep, and the wind drove the flames toward the stalls where people traded with babies in their arms. Teo climbed onto a barrel and shouted — no words, just his full brass horn of a voice. They heard him at the South Gate, and the market got out in time. Next morning the choirmaster was silent a long while, then said: “For a cathedral you’re too loud. For a fire you’re just right.” Teo signed up for the novice camp: they say you’re allowed to shout there. His mother cried as she saw him off. Loudly. It runs in the family.
Прежде чем отпустить Тео в лагерь новичк: Before letting Teo go to the novice camp, the cathedral had him pass the acolyte trial: a pilgrimage to three hermits. The hermits heard him a mile off. The second had taken a vow of silence and wrote on a slate: “Quieter.” Teo whispered “sorry” — and the hermit’s mug fell off the table. A quiet girl from the orphanage walked with him; she was afraid to sleep in the woods. Teo sang to her the whole way, until he was hoarse. The girl’s name was Vika. She never once said it helped. Teo knew anyway.
Благословение на всю улицу: A Blessing for the Whole Street
Первое благословение Тео произнёс над од: Teo spoke his first blessing over a single guard at the cathedral gate. The whole street ended up blessed: the guard, two merchants, the baker, the baker’s horse and, rumor has it, the dough in his oven — the bread rose twice as high that day. The sister who taught the acolytes spent a long time explaining that a blessing doesn’t get stronger with volume. Teo nodded. Loudly. The next day the baker came asking for an encore. The sister gave up.
Испытание жрецов — ночь у изгнанных духо: The priest trial is a night among exorcised spirits and a morning at a sickbed. Teo sang the spirits off in an hour — they simply left, covering their ears. The examiner noted they were supposed to be calmed, not deafened. In the morning, at the bedside of a sick girl, Teo spoke in a whisper for the first time in his life — a real, quiet one. It worked. A new priest writes the first name on the list of those he prays for. Teo wrote: “The choirmaster.” The very one who threw him out for being loud. It’s more honest that way, Teo said.
У колодца Тео попробовал молитву вполгол: At the well, Teo tried a prayer at half voice. Every pigeon in Prontera took off; the guards grabbed their swords, the merchants their purses. The High Priest finished the prayer, bowed and heard applause. Then he hid in the Two Bells out of shame. That evening he still went out to tell the watch there was no alarm. His voice can’t simply be turned down, but he can answer for what it does to a square. Teo cleared his next prayer with the watch shift — without giving up singing.
Регент прислал одно слово: «Громче». Тео: The choirmaster sent a single word: “Louder.” Teo cried so hard that Bruno came running with a towel. After the pigeons, the choirmaster understood: a voice should be placed where it’s needed, not hidden. The High Priest tucked the note between the pages of the funeral rite. Then he set to work on his breathing: through a long service, his voice must reach the last line. He took the words of the man who threw him out of the choir not as permission to make noise, but as trust in a task he would now have to carry.
В соборе Гласт Хейма колыбельная жрецов: In the Glast Heim cathedral, the priests’ lullaby was calling the dead. Teo stood in the nave and began the funeral rite, loud and off-key. The High Priest held his breath line by line while his comrades carried out the wounded. The lullaby faltered; the dead began to lie down, hearing that it was time. He added no victory shout: forty children were being mourned here. “Louder” finally made sense. His voice had to drown out the call, not the people who came to remember.
У врат Нифльхейма голосу Тео наконец был: At the gates of Niflheim, Teo’s voice finally had room. He could have stayed to sing for the dead, but chose the road back: the living in the fog need to hear which way to go. Every evening the High Priest sings from the northern post, saving water and breath until the next shift. Garret says you could set a clock by him. The choirmaster wrote: “I hear you.” Teo keeps both notes side by side. One listener on the far end of the road is enough not to break off the song.
Испытание обители святой Капитолины — не: The trial of Saint Capitolina’s abbey is a week of silence and a hundred punches to a sandbag. For Teo, silence is scarier than the bag: in the quiet, it feels like he no longer exists. He held out six days, teeth clenched. On the seventh night a thief broke into the abbey, and Teo shouted. The thief fainted, the brothers woke up, a cup in the refectory cracked. The abbot was silent a long while — per the rule. Then he wrote on a slate: “A fist is a prayer too. Yours is a loud one.” And handed Teo his knuckles.
В «Двух колоколах» Тео просидел вечер мо: Teo spent an evening in the Two Bells in silence. It’s easier for a Champion to gather his spirit into a fist than to not fill the quiet with his horn. Bruno asked if he was ill; Greta touched his forehead; the mercenaries switched to whispers on their own. Teo didn’t make them — for the first time he listened to what tired people say. By midnight you could hear a clock the hall doesn’t have. He whispered: “Thank you.” Everyone exhaled. Silence turned out not to be Teo vanishing, but a space he could give to others.
В башне Альдебарана грохот съедал приказ: In the Al De Baran tower, the clatter swallowed every order. Teo stepped up to Alan: “Left,” — in a whisper. Alan heard. A Champion’s “inner voice” cut through the noise without extra force. All fight long Teo passed on short warnings, making sure each one was understood, not just heard. After the victory he roared with joy; the gears stopped for a moment. The archivist never figured out why. Teo apologized for the scare, but not for the joy. He was learning to tell those two responsibilities apart.
В Гласт Хейме мёртвые шли строем под кол: In Glast Heim the dead marched in ranks to the lullaby. Teo didn’t sing over it: the Champion gathered his spirit and struck with a single cry, picking the pause between lines. The singing broke off, the ranks froze; the squad got time to fall back. Teo didn’t repeat the blow for the noise of it — he needed his breath for the next pass. Dorn called it the best hit of the campaign, though the fist touched no one. “It did. With my voice.” Teo knew how much strength went into one word without words.
У Врат Тео выучил паузу, в которой слышн: At the Gates, Teo learned the pause in which you can hear that you’re still alive. Now the Champion can fall silent in battle, holding his spirit until the right blow; enemies freeze before the cry. The cathedral is calling him back as choirmaster. Teo promised to think about it so loudly the whole quarter heard. Then he didn’t rush to accept: the squad still has a place for him and people who need to learn to listen to each other. If he returns to the choir, he won’t throw a boy out just for a voice that’s too strong.
Алан вырос в деревне у Пронтеры, где у к: Alan grew up in a village near Prontera, where every boy has a stick for a sword and dreams of a knight’s shield. He was first at everything: first onto the roof, first into the river, first to get a hiding from his father. At the training camp he challenged the instructor and lost, but so beautifully that people remembered. He has one dream — the shield of a Prontera knight. Captain Garret won’t give it to him: “Learn to retreat.” Alan thinks it’s mockery. What he fears most isn’t death, but someone seeing him take a step back.
Алан встаёт первым. Даже если все сидят: Alan stands up first. Even when everyone’s sitting and nobody’s going anywhere.
Перед зеркалом в «Двух колоколах» Алан р: In front of the mirror at the Two Bells, Alan rehearses the knight’s oath. Bruno pretends not to hear.
Отступать Алан не умеет. Зато научился «: Alan doesn’t know how to retreat. He has, however, learned to “regroup.”
Бран вырос на ферме у Пронтеры. Мать раб: Bran grew up on a farm near Prontera. His mother worked for two and still died in debt, and the farm was seized for nonpayment. Bran was twelve; he remembered every figure on that receipt. Since then he counts everything: arrows, coins, steps to the target, other people’s debts. He came to the novice camp with a notebook and a bow, and the notebook filled up before the quiver. His greatest fear is that someone will once again owe someone, and they’ll come to collect. He dreams of everything adding up. In life it never does — which is why he’s so snarky.
Бран пересчитывает сдачу дважды. Даже ес: Bran counts the change twice. Even when he wasn’t the one paying.
В тетради Брана есть графа «Алан». Она т: Bran’s notebook has a column labeled “Alan.” It’s thicker than all the others combined.
Бран не верит в то, что нельзя посчитать: Bran doesn’t believe in what can’t be counted. Friendship, for example. Yet somehow he’s always there.
Вику принёс к приюту собора Пронтеры бра: Vika was brought to the orphanage of the Prontera cathedral by her teenage brother — in a bread basket. She was raised by Father Benedict, the abbot: he taught her prayers, darning and not to fear the dark. She doesn’t fear the dark. She fears blood — ever since the plague, when she helped Father Benedict at the bedsides of forty children. Then he vanished, and everyone decided he was dead. Vika joined the clergy to become someone whose hands don’t shake. Her hands shake. But she always has bandages on her, and she never abandons the wounded — not once.
«Бинты со мной». Вика говорит это вместо: “Bandages are with me.” Vika says it instead of “good morning.”
Вика бледнеет при виде крови — и перевяз: Vika goes pale at the sight of blood — and bandages faster than anyone in the squad.
Вика до сих пор поправляет бирету перед: Vika still straightens her biretta in the mirror the way Father Benedict taught her.
Vika snuffs a candle with her palm: “Sleep, little flame.” Her brother used to do that. For ten years she’s snuffed candles alone.
Грета — старшая дочь трактирщика Бруно и: Greta is the eldest daughter of Bruno, keeper of the Two Bells, and in her family every eldest daughter is named Greta. Why, nobody remembers anymore. She grew up behind the bar, has haggled with suppliers since she was nine and collected debts with a frying pan since twelve. She guarded the little bell over the tavern door since childhood: her grandmother told her to. Grandmother also told her never to let in people in grey hoods. When one of them tore down the bell, Greta chased him with her frying pan and didn’t stop until Mastering swallowed her. She has no fear. No family history either. Yet.
Грета торгуется даже с мёртвыми. Мёртвые: Greta haggles even with the dead. The dead give in.
Greta washes her frying pan only after a fight. Before a fight — bad luck.
Три часа в желе Мастеринга Грета вспомин: Greta remembers her three hours inside Mastering’s jelly as “a bad deal.”
Колокольчик звенит только у Греты. Она с: The little bell rings only for Greta. She believes it’s because it respects her.
Дорн вырос в Морроке, в тени пирамид, и: Dorn grew up in Morroc, in the shadow of the pyramids, and learned early that his fists were bigger than everyone else’s. The Thieves’ Guild took him under its wing, then billed him for the wing. The debt grew faster than Dorn did. He hauled cargo, worked doors, beat other people’s debts out of them — and always fought fair, until someone made him angry. The guild’s last job: carry a black box to a client in a grey hood, through the culverts under Prontera. Dorn looked inside, heard the sand whispering in the voices of the dead, and refused. Bugs dragged off the box, and Dorn was driven into a dead end. What he’s most ashamed of is his past. He dreams of owing no one.
Дорн дерётся честно. Пока его не разозли: Dorn fights fair. Until you make him angry. Don’t make Dorn angry.
Дорн заглядывает в каждый ящик, который: Dorn looks inside every box he’s asked to carry. Lesson learned.
Зара помнит, как маленький Дорн плакал н: Zara remembers little Dorn crying over a dead scorpion. Dorn denies it.
Ирис с детства хотела служить в ордене П: Since childhood Iris wanted to serve in the Prontera order, and she served well — best on the parade ground, best in formation. Then came a battle where three wounded lay beyond the line, and her shield got in the way of carrying them. Iris dropped the shield and carried all three out. The order expelled her: a knight never drops her shield. Since then she fights with a two-hander and considers a shield dead weight. Iris came to Glast Heim for the tags of fallen knights — Garret’s squad among them — to return them to their families. She fears only one thing: having to choose between the rules and people again.
Ирис носит на поясе чужие жетоны. Не сво: Iris wears other people’s tags on her belt. Not her own — those of fallen knights whose families don’t know yet.
Щит Ирис считает лишним весом. Раненого: Iris considers a shield dead weight. A wounded comrade on her shoulders — never.
Ирис и Гаррет говорят друг с другом мало: Iris and Garret rarely talk. A nod is enough for them.
Отто — возчик из Альберты, третий в роду: Otto is a carter from Alberta, third in his line. His grandfather hauled fish, his father cloth; Otto hauls anything that pays. His cart, creaky and beloved, crossed half of Midgard until it was swept down a manhole by Prontera’s South Gate. Otto didn’t leave: he’s hunting for it in the sewers, wheel by wheel, plank by plank, nail by nail. He knows how to trade, but cheaply, and he doesn’t like fighting — he just stands there, and enemies break against him. He dreams of a cart no manhole can swallow. He fears being left without work: for a carter, that’s worse than death.
Отто называет тележку «она». С людьми он: Otto calls his cart “she.” He’s less polite with people.
Грета пыталась купить у Отто колесо. Отт: Greta tried to buy a wheel from Otto. Otto tried to sell her two.
Отто скрипит так же, как его тележка. Го: Otto creaks just like his cart. He says it’s an occupational thing.
Зара выросла в гильдии воров Моррока вме: Zara grew up in the Morroc Thieves’ Guild alongside Dorn and was the best at the trade: fast, quiet, with poison on every knife. When the Grey Hood asked the guild to steal the key to the pyramid, Zara refused. Set, the guild master, framed her: accused her of stealing the treasury. Zara left for the Sograt Desert, alone, with a pair of knives and a name that now carried a hefty price. She doesn’t dream of revenge — she plans it. She’s afraid to trust, but even more afraid of becoming like Set.
Зара приставляет нож к горлу при встрече: Zara puts a knife to your throat when you meet. It’s not a threat, it’s a question.
Зара знает три пути в любую гробницу. Че: Zara knows three ways into any tomb. The fourth goes through Dorn.
Тот, кто подставил Зару, уже знает. Зара: The one who framed Zara already knows. Zara makes sure he never sleeps soundly.
Мэйлин — дочь пайонского лесничего. Отец: Meilin is the daughter of a Payon forester. Her father taught her to read tracks before letters, and she held a bow before a spoon. This spring her father vanished along with the villagers, and a white wolf carried off his bow — Meilin saw it herself. She followed the wolf into the thicket, raining Arrow Showers on everything in her way. She dreams of bringing back her father and his bow. She fears the silence of the forest: when the birds go quiet, something is wrong in Payon.
Мэйлин здоровается с деревьями. Некоторы: Meilin says hello to trees. Some of them, she says, answer.
Мэйлин различает следы трёх видов лис. И: Meilin can tell apart the tracks of three kinds of fox. And Bran’s tracks — by the smell of ink.
Белый волк не враг. Мэйлин повторяет это: The white wolf is not an enemy. Meilin keeps saying so and still keeps an arrow on the string.
Кай учился в Гефенской башне и был самым: Kai studied at Geffen Tower and was the most talented and most dangerous student of his year. Fire came easily to him; stopping fire, not at all. One night he tried to warm up some tea and burned down the library. The Tower billed him a debt the size of the Tower. He was sent to Izlude to study the green lights under the water, and there he tried to boil the bay — and cooked every fish in Izlude. Kai dreams of a spell that, at last, nobody will have to put out. He fears that one day his sister won’t make it in time.
Кай сначала жжёт, потом думает. Потом сн: Kai burns first, thinks later. Then burns again, because he thought about it.
Библиотекари Гефена прячут от Кая свитки: Geffen’s librarians hide their scrolls from Kai. And the matches. And the tea.
Рыбаки Излуда до сих пор не здороваются: Izlude’s fishermen still don’t say hello to Kai. They do remember the fish soup, though.
Лира — сестра Кая, младше на год и старш: Lira is Kai’s sister — a year younger and a whole lifetime older. At Geffen Tower she studied ice and warding signs — at first because someone had to put out her brother. Then she fell in love with it: ice is honest, it holds. When Kai burned the library, Lira spent a week freezing the ashes to save at least the spines. At Izlude she made an ice bubble of air for the dive to the Sunken Ship. She dreams of one day practicing her own magic instead of putting out other people’s fires. She fears she won’t be able to leave her brother, even when she has to.
Лира чинит всё, что сжёг Кай. Список дли: Lira fixes everything Kai burns. The list is long.
У Лиры в кармане всегда кусочек льда. На: Lira always keeps a chip of ice in her pocket. Just in case — meaning Kai.
Лира говорит тихо. Кай слышит её сквозь: Lira speaks softly. Kai hears her through any fire.
Тео пел в хоре собора Пронтеры с восьми: Teo sang in the Prontera cathedral choir from the age of eight. He sang well — and louder than anyone. The choirmaster asked him to be quieter; Teo tried, but his voice wouldn’t obey. When his “amen” cracked a stained-glass window, Teo was thrown out. The cathedral sent him to sing the funeral rite at the Gates of the Dead in Niflheim: “Nobody can hold him back anyway.” The dead can’t stand noise, and Teo survived where the quiet ones wouldn’t have. He dreams of his voice being of use to someone. He fears silence — in it, he feels like he no longer exists.
Тео шепчет так, что слышно на соседней у: Teo whispers so you can hear it on the next street.
The dead of Niflheim give Teo a wide berth. He thinks it’s out of respect.
Тео молится вслух. Даже когда просто дум: Teo prays out loud. Even when he’s just thinking.
Первый нож каждого новичка из тренировоч: Every novice’s first knife from the training camp. It cuts bread, rope and, with luck, a Poring.
Короткий кинжал, который удобно прятать: A short dagger that hides nicely in a boot. Morroc’s thieves say: “A dagger isn’t a weapon, it’s an argument.”
Простой прямой меч из кузниц Пронтеры. С: A plain straight sword from the forges of Prontera. Every knight started with one — and half of them finished with the same.
Охотничий лук из пайонского тиса. Лучник: A hunting bow of Payon yew. Payon’s archers carve their name on the grip so the bow remembers its owner.
Лёгкий жезл новичка-мага, вырезанный из: A novice mage’s light rod, carved from a Geffen ash branch. It sparks from nerves more often than from spells.
Топор дровосека, которым торговцы Альбер: A woodcutter’s axe that Alberta merchants use to chop both crates and prices. Heavy, but reliable, like a good contract.
Короткий широкий меч старых легионов. Ег: A short, broad sword of the old legions. Loved by everyone who fights up close: swordmen, thieves and merchants who refuse to back down.
Лук, склеенный из рога, дерева и жил. Бь: A bow glued together from horn, wood and sinew. It shoots farther than yew, but drawing it is a workout of its own.
Посох мага, окованный медью. Башня Гефен: A mage’s staff bound in copper. Geffen Tower hands it out after the first exam — along with a ban on burning the library.
Булава служителей церкви: клинком святым: A cleric’s mace: holy fathers aren’t supposed to shed blood with a blade, but a good whack is allowed.
Кастет монахов святой Капитолины. Настоя: Knuckles of the monks of Saint Capitolina. The abbot hands them out after the vow of humility — and apparently sees no contradiction.
Старая скрипка, выменянная у рокера. Бар: An old violin traded from a Rocker. Bards swear that summer on the Prontera fields still chirps inside its soundboard.
Двуручный клеймор, выше иного новичка. Р: A two-handed claymore, taller than some novices. Prontera’s knights joke that it doesn’t need a shield — enemies just don’t come close.
Тяжёлый арбалет с воротом. Охотники Хьюд: A heavy crossbow with a winch. Hugel’s hunters take it for big game — and for those who think they’re big game.
Катар — клинок с поперечной рукоятью, пр: The katar — a blade with a cross grip, an extension of the fist. Sograt’s assassins receive their first pair after the desert trial.
Посох чародея с камнем, в котором дремле: A wizard’s staff with a stone in which a storm slumbers. Geffen Tower graduates guard it like a diploma — and like a lightning rod.
Двуручный боевой топор кузнецов Эйнброха: A two-handed battle axe of Einbroch’s blacksmiths. They forge with it, chop with it and, if it comes to that, haggle with it.
Изогнутый ятаган караванщиков Сограта. Н: A curved scimitar of the Sograt caravaneers. The sheath smells of sand and cinnamon, the blade of the Thieves’ Guild’s unpaid debts.
Кинжал с лезвием бледным, как луна над П: A dagger with a blade as pale as the moon over Payon. They say Moonlight Flower dropped it, and on full-moon nights it rings thinly, like a little bell.
Сабля с корабля Дрейка, ржавая по рукоят: A saber from Drake’s ship, rusty to the hilt and sharp along its whole length. A hundred years underwater haven’t dulled it.
Топор с рукоятью, которая никогда не выс: An axe whose haft never dries. Who wielded it in Niflheim is unknown; what is known is that it wants more.
Хлопковая рубаха из тренировочного лагер: A cotton shirt from the training camp. Every novice gets one, and every novice freezes in it equally.
Костюм с десятком карманов. Искатели кла: A suit with a dozen pockets. Adventurers stash a map, matches, bandages — and forget which pocket holds what.
Кольчуга из тысяч колечек. Стража Пронте: Chain mail of thousands of tiny rings. Prontera’s guards wear it on duty and mend it with pliers on breaks.
Шёлковая мантия с вышивкой по подолу. Ма: A silk robe with an embroidered hem. Mages love it for its lightness, swordmen for how easily it tears.
Полные латы рыцаря Пронтеры. Надевают их: The full plate of a Prontera knight. It takes two to put on, three to take off, and years to learn to run in.
Белое одеяние жрецов собора Пронтеры. Го: The white vestment of Prontera cathedral’s priests. They say bloodstains wash out on their own — if you wear it with a pure heart.
Мантия из шёлка и змеиной кожи, снятая с: A robe of silk and snakeskin, taken from a pyramid priestess. On a hot day it cools your shoulders. On a cold one, too.
Тёмный костюм из далёкого Амацу. Шуршит: A dark suit from faraway Amatsu. It rustles so quietly that its owner was once left behind at camp.
Камзол капитана с медными пуговицами и с: A captain’s coat with brass buttons and salt stains. Drake wore one like it — for a hundred years, never taking it off.
Чёрная мантия с церковного двора Гласт Х: A black robe from the churchyard of Glast Heim, smelling of candle wax and cold stone. A horned sign is stitched under the collar.
Плетёные сандалии новичка. Хороши на луг: A novice’s woven sandals. Good in a meadow, bad in a swamp, and every other Fabre bites them.
Крепкие кожаные башмаки. Кафра рекоменду: Sturdy leather shoes. Kafra recommends breaking them in before the journey, not during it.
Сапоги с высоким голенищем, чтобы гусени: High-topped boots to keep caterpillars out. In the culverts under Prontera, that’s the most valuable advice there is.
Стальные поножи мечников Излуда. Звенят: Steel greaves of Izlude’s swordmen. They clank with every step, but your knees stay whole after any brawl.
Сапоги, названные в честь Слейпнира — во: Boots named after Sleipnir — Odin’s eight-legged steed that gallops between worlds. Whoever wears them never tires on the road and never loses the way, even in Niflheim.
Сандалии с широкой подошвой, чтобы не вя: Wide-soled sandals so you don’t sink into the Sograt sand. Caravaneers pass them from father to son.
Деревянные сандалии с Амацу на двух высо: Wooden sandals from Amatsu on two tall blocks. Clack-clack on stone — and the enemy knows you’re coming. But it’s already too late.
Сапоги морского волка, пропитанные дёгте: Sea-dog boots soaked in tar. Waterproof, non-slip on deck, and very squelchy on land.
Сапоги валькирий, что уносят павших геро: The boots of the Valkyries who carry fallen heroes to Odin’s halls. Your step in them is light, as if you had wings — and heavy for anyone standing in your way.
Бандана из тренировочного лагеря. Держит: A bandana from the training camp. Holds back sweat, hair and what’s left of your dignity after your first Poring.
Простая шапка с козырьком. Новички носят: A simple cap with a visor. Novices wear it backwards, veterans pulled down over their eyes.
Стальной шлем стражи Пронтеры. В стоках: A steel helm of the Prontera guard. In the sewers under the capital they were found empty — the veterans had followed the voices.
Квадратная шапочка жрецов собора. Отец Б: The square cap of the cathedral’s priests. Father Benedict put one on every morning — and taught the orphans to straighten it.
Маленькая золотая корона, липкая с изнан: A small golden crown, sticky on the inside. They say Mastering wore it — and wept when he lost it.
Полосатый убор фараона с золотой коброй: A pharaoh’s striped headdress with a golden cobra over the brow. Mummies bow to whoever wears it. Sometimes.
Лисья маска из пайонского храма. В ней с: A fox mask from a Payon temple. In it you laugh with someone else’s voice, and foxes take you for one of their own.
Красная бандана с корабля Дрейка, выцвет: A red bandana from Drake’s ship, bleached by salt. The knot at the back is tied so it won’t come undone in a hundred years.
Чёрный шлем из оружейной Гласт Хейма. В: A black helm from the Glast Heim armory. Inside it you can’t hear the call of the dead — only your own heart. They say that is the darkness.
Молот, которым смотритель часовой башни: The hammer the Al De Baran Clock Tower Manager used to tighten the gears. It strikes exactly on the beat — as if someone inside were counting seconds.
Кольчуга из мелких латунных колец с пруж: Mail of small brass rings with springs on the shoulders. Made by Al De Baran’s clockmakers: fits snugly and ticks softly as you walk.
Маска с циферблатом вместо лица, снятая: A mask with a clock face instead of a face, taken from the Clock Tower’s Alarm. Its wearer never oversleeps. Sometimes it rings by itself — at 3:13.
Мягкие сапоги с совиными перьями на голе: Soft boots with owl feathers on the shafts. In them you walk soundlessly, like the owls under the vaults of Al De Baran, and see the steps in the dark.
Чёрный клинок рыцаря бездны с моста Глас: The black blade of an Abysmal Knight from the Glast Heim bridge. The air turns cold around it. On the guard — the worn crest of the Prontera guard.
Поножи рыцаря ночного караула Гласт Хейм: Greaves of a Glast Heim night-watch knight. For centuries they marched from post to post by regulation, and they still keep step on their own.
Доспех валькирий, что уносят павших геро: The armor of the Valkyries who carry fallen heroes to Odin’s halls. Light as a wing and cold as the fog over the river Gyoll.
Шлем стражей моста Гьёлль, золотой и узк: The helm of the Gyoll Bridge wardens, golden and narrow as the bridge itself. Beneath it you can’t hear other voices — only the toll you set yourself.
Все начинают в тренировочном лагере у Пр: Everyone starts at the training camp near Prontera: a cotton shirt, a knife and an instructor who has seen a thousand like you. There’s one trial — survive until you choose your path. The camp motto is written in charcoal over the gate: “First the Poring, then the glory.”
Гильдия мечников — в Излуде, в зале с ви: The Swordman Guild is in Izlude, in a hall overlooking the sea. The trial is an obstacle course over the water: fall in and you start over, soaking wet, to the laughter of your seniors. Tradition: a new swordman gives his first wooden sword to the next novice.
Гильдия магов живёт в Гефене, в тени вел: The Mage Guild lives in Geffen, in the shadow of the great tower. The trial is mixing a solution from a recipe where one extra drop turns the exam into a fire. The guild motto is carved over the door: “Think first. Then cast.” Kai never read it.
Гильдия лучников — в Пайоне, среди сосен: The Archer Guild is in Payon, among the pines and smoky temples. The trial is to cut logs in the forest and bring them back without breaking a single arrow on the way. Tradition: an archer carves their name on the bow so it remembers its owner.
Аколитов принимает собор Пронтеры. Испыт: Acolytes are accepted by the Prontera cathedral. The trial is a pilgrimage to three hermits in the wilds of Midgard, on foot and without complaint. The clergy’s motto: “The light is not the one who shines, but the one who doesn’t go out.”
Гильдия торговцев — в портовой Альберте,: The Merchant Guild is in the port of Alberta, which smells of fish, tar and money. The trial is to deliver a parcel across half the world and come back with a Kafra receipt. Motto: “Everything has a price. Especially what’s free.”
Гильдия воров прячется у пирамиды близ М: The Thieves’ Guild hides by a pyramid near Morroc, and only those who know the way get in. The trial is to gather mushrooms on the guild farm without getting caught by the watchmen. The guild rule is simple: debts are forgiven only to the dead — and not always then.
Рыцари Пронтеры принимают клятву в замке: Prontera’s knights take their oath in the king’s castle, before the ranks and the banner. The trial is to endure a battle where what matters isn’t winning, but not leaving your own behind. The order’s motto: “The shield is for another.” Whoever understands this gets a shield.
Орден Креста служит при соборе Пронтеры:: The Order of the Cross serves the Prontera cathedral: knights whose weapons are faith and shield. The trial is a long fast and a night on watch by the tombs of fallen brothers. A Crusader takes others’ wounds upon himself; the order’s motto: “My shield is your life.”
Волшебники живут в Гефенской башне, на с: Wizards live in Geffen Tower, on its uppermost floors, out of the examiners’ reach. The trial is to survive a duel with the elements in the tower’s dungeon without destroying the tower. The librarians add a second condition: don’t burn the books.
Мудрецы учатся в Академии Юно, городе на: Sages study at Juno Academy, in a city on a floating island. The trial isn’t a spell but a debate: prove to the council that you know why magic works. The Academy’s motto: “To understand is to win without fire.”
Гильдия охотников стоит в Хьюджеле, у оз: The Hunter Guild stands in Hugel, by the lake and forests. The trial is to track a beast by three signs, set a trap and tame a falcon. The falcon chooses its own master; whoever it doesn’t choose will never be a hunter.
Барды собираются в Комодо, в пещерном го: Bards gather in Comodo, a cave city where nights are longer than days. The trial is to sing so that the tavern falls silent. Tradition: a bard’s first song is about those they love, and the second about whoever owes them.
Танцовщицы Комодо выступают на пляжах по: Comodo’s dancers perform on the beaches under lanterns, and that’s where they take their trial: dancing until dawn, until the orchestra tires. The troupe’s motto: “A step throws the enemy off — a smile finishes him.”
Гильдия кузнецов — в Эйнброхе, городе ды: The Blacksmith Guild is in Einbroch, the city of smoke and gears. The trial is to forge a blade the senior master can’t break. Tradition: the master stamps his mark on the hilt and answers for every blow.
Алхимики трудятся в Альдебаране, у часов: Alchemists work in Al De Baran, by the Clock Tower. The trial is to brew a potion from a recipe without a single mistake, then explain every drop. The guild motto: “Precision is kindness”; imprecise alchemists don’t live long.
Гильдия ассасинов скрыта в песках Сограт: The Assassin Guild is hidden in the Sograt sands, in a nameless oasis. The trial is to cross the desert to the guild without being spotted by the watchmen. Those who make it get katars; those who are spotted get a lesson.
Разбойники собираются у Комодо, в пещера: Rogues gather near Comodo, in caves above the sea. There’s no trial: the guild expects you to find the entrance yourself and talk the guards around. Motto: “An honest rogue takes only from those who took first.”
Жрецы служат в соборе Пронтеры, под свод: Priests serve in the Prontera cathedral, under vaults where every prayer can be heard. The trial is a night among exorcised spirits and a morning at a sickbed. Tradition: a new priest receives a biretta and the first name on their list of those they pray for.
Монахи живут в обители святой Капитолины: Monks live in the abbey of Saint Capitolina north of Prontera. The trial is a week of silence and a hundred punches to a sandbag without a single complaint. The abbot says: “A fist is a prayer too, just a short one.”
Кузнец долго смотрит на вещь, потом на в: The blacksmith stares at the item for a long time, then at you. “Don’t sell it. To anyone.”
Кузнец стучит по металлу ногтем и одобри: The blacksmith taps the metal with a fingernail and grunts approvingly. The fingernail stays on the anvil.
Кузнец протирает вещь фартуком и впервые: The blacksmith wipes the item with his apron and smiles for the first time today. The apprentice steps back, just in case.
«Руда легла как родная», — говорит кузне: “The ore took to it like family,” says the blacksmith, stamping his mark on the inside. Small. Modest. Golden.
Кузнец откладывает молот и зовёт жену по: The blacksmith puts down his hammer and calls his wife to come look. She looks, nods and leaves. That’s the highest praise.
Искры гаснут, металл поёт. Кузнец записы: The sparks die, the metal sings. The blacksmith writes in his notebook: “Don’t repeat. Got lucky.”
Бран сверяет цену с результатом и молча: Bran checks the price against the result and silently closes his notebook. No debts on this one.
Кузнец откладывает молот: «Спешка металл: The blacksmith sets down his hammer: “Haste is no friend to metal.” The old mark is intact.
Руда не легла. Кузнец возвращает вещь: о: The ore didn’t take. The blacksmith hands the item back: it’s the same as before the attempt.
Подмастерье подносит воду. Сегодня метал: The apprentice brings water. Today the metal decided not to change.
Кузнец проверяет швы и кивает: «Не приба: The blacksmith checks the seams and nods: “Didn’t gain anything, but kept it all.”
В журнале кузнеца появляется пометка: «П: A note appears in the blacksmith’s log: “Retry with different ore.”
Гаррет: «Отступили — значит, живы. Живые: Garret: “We fell back — so we’re alive. The living come back.”
Гаррет перевязывает Алану руку и говорит: Garret bandages Alan’s arm and says only: “Again. In formation.”
Гаррет чертит на земле новую расстановку: Garret draws a new formation in the dirt. He scuffs out the old one with his boot — with special feeling.
Вика пересчитывает бинты. Хватило. В сле: Vika counts the bandages. There were enough. Next time, may they not be needed.
Гаррет смотрит на поле боя: «Враг сильне: Garret surveys the battlefield: “The enemy is stronger — for now. You’re growing; he isn’t.”
Бран записывает в тетрадь: «Поражение №…: Bran writes in his notebook: “Defeat No. …” He refuses to show the number.
Гаррет ставит новичкам по кружке в «Двух: Garret buys the rookies a mug each at the Two Bells. Empty. “A full one — after a win.”
На стене мелом: «Здесь был Алан». Ниже,: Chalked on the wall: “Alan was here.” Below, in Bran’s handwriting: “And here he was carried out.”
На камне нацарапана стрелка вверх и прип: Scratched on a stone: an arrow pointing up and a note: “That way. No need to thank me.” The arrow points at the ceiling.
На ступеньке вырезано: «Отдохни». На сле: Carved on one step: “Rest.” On the next: “Enough resting.”
На стене — счёт углём: палочки, палочки,: A tally in charcoal on the wall: strokes, strokes, strokes. Someone was counting floors. Or days.
Надпись на двери: «Кафра выше не работае: A sign on the door: “No Kafra above this point.” Below, in another hand: “There is. But it costs more.”
Под окном этажа стоит кружка из «Двух ко: Under the floor’s window sits a mug from the Two Bells. Bruno will be glad: he’s been looking for it for ages.
На стене почерком Греты: «Сдачи наверху: On the wall, in Greta’s handwriting: “No change given upstairs.” Verified.
Разведчики стряхивают дорожную пыль. Каф: The scouts shake off the road dust. Kafra lays the loot out on the counter.
The squad came back with loot and a new song. By the second verse at the campfire, they were out of strength.
Экспедиция вернулась. Кафра пересчитывае: The expedition is back. Kafra counts the loot twice. It matches.
Возвращаются молча и довольные. Тот, кто: They return silent and satisfied. Whoever carried the map insists everything went according to plan.
На карте появилась новая тропа. Тот, кто: A new trail has appeared on the map. Whoever found it is already arguing about what to call it.
Из сумки разведчика выпадает чужое письм: Someone else’s letter falls out of a scout’s bag. It will definitely be returned. Maybe.
Поринги едят всё, что упало в траву. Не: Porings eat anything that falls in the grass. Don’t drop anything valuable in the southern fields.
Трактир зовётся «Два колокола», а колоко: The tavern is called the Two Bells, yet there’s only one bell over the door. Bruno doesn’t know why. Grandmother did.
Гаррет не берёт в рыцари тех, кто не уме: Garret won’t knight anyone who can’t retreat. The list of knights is short.
Кафра хранит вещи бережно. Особенно те,: Kafra stores your things with care. Especially the ones someone paid to store.
The World Tree holds three worlds on its roots. The roots, they say, creak sometimes.
Bran has kept a ledger of debts since day one. The first line in it is a bandage.
Кузнец лавки уверяет, что руда бывает с: The shop’s blacksmith insists that ore can have character. Usually it’s the blacksmith who has it.
Зелёная гусеница с мягким пухом на спине: A green caterpillar with soft fuzz on its back. It chews clover by the Prontera fences all day and bites if you step on it. Novices take its fuzz for their first patches. Left alone, a Fabre will pupate, and in spring a butterfly will rise over the meadow — but few live to see spring.
«Пушистая гусеничка» — так говорят все н: “A fluffy little caterpillar” — that’s what every novice says. Until the first bite.
Пупа — Фабр, который решил подождать. Он: A Pupa is a Fabre that decided to wait. It hangs on a fence, doesn’t eat and doesn’t answer blows — it just hardens. Something stirs inside and seems to be asleep. Novices hit it for half an hour and walk away with bruised hands and a respect for patience.
Пупа никуда не спешит. У Пупы — весна вп: Pupa is in no hurry. Pupa has spring ahead.
Поринг — круглый розовый комок желе с гл: A Poring is a round pink blob of jelly with eyes and an eternal smile. It bounces around, collects anything shiny and swallows without chewing: inside a Poring you might find an apple, a coin and someone’s key. Usually docile. This year the Porings are running toward the village, and that in itself is a bad sign.
Поринги не злые. Просто очень голодные —: Porings aren’t evil. Just very hungry — and very bouncy.
Попоринг — родня поринга, только зелёный: A Poporing is a Poring’s relative, only green and a bit sour. It loves grapes and damp lowlands and leaves a sticky, poisonous trail behind. Payon’s herbalists are sure the green comes from indigestion.
Если желе зелёное — не пробуй. Грета про: If the jelly is green, don’t taste it. Greta did.
Дропс — оранжевый поринг из песков Согра: A Drops is an orange Poring from the Sograt sands. How it reached the Prontera fields, nobody knows, but it’s been stubbornly bouncing here ever since. It smells of orange inside. Hot to the touch: it basks on the rocks all day.
Drops isn’t lost. Drops is traveling.
Марин — водяной поринг, прозрачный и про: Marin is a water Poring, clear and cool as morning by a spring. She stays behind her kin and sprinkles them with clean water, which closes the wounds in their jelly. If a Marin is nearby, hit her first — or the fight will be long and wet.
Сначала — ту, что лечит. Даже если она п: First, the one who heals. Even if she looks like a dewdrop.
Люнатик — белый кролик с длинным ухом и: A Lunatic is a white rabbit with one long ear and a quiet longing in its eyes. They say at night it gazes at the moon, waiting to be taken back. By day it steals carrots from gardens and kicks painfully. Sometimes four-leaf clovers are dug out of its burrows.
Люнатик не кусается. Он пинается — и это: Lunatics don’t bite. They kick — and that’s worse.
Рокер — большой кузнечик, который играет: A Rocker is a big grasshopper that plays the violin. It plays badly, but with feeling, and gets very angry if interrupted. Bards trade Rockers for their old violins: they say the summer chirping stays inside.
Рокер не любит критиков. Рокер их пинает: Rocker doesn’t like critics. Rocker kicks them.
Мандрагора сидит в земле и не уходит — з: A Mandragora sits in the ground and doesn’t budge — instead it lashes its roots at anyone who gets close. An old legend says its scream drives mad whoever pulls up the root. Al De Baran’s alchemists pay well for mandragora, but nobody’s in a hurry to pull one up.
Мандрагору не выкапывают. Мандрагору обх: You don’t dig up a Mandragora. You walk around it.
Старая ива с лицом в коре. Столетиями ст: An old willow with a face in its bark. For centuries it stood by a stream, and now it walks, creaks and blocks the path. It hits slowly but takes a blow like a true guardian. It drops roots and chips that carpenters call “willow wood with character.”
Ива не злится. Ива просто стоит там, где: The Willow isn’t angry. It’s just standing where you wanted to go.
Мертвец, который не спит: The Dead Man Who Doesn’t Sleep
Зомби бредёт медленно и неуклюже, но не: A Zombie shambles slowly and clumsily, but never tires. Once he was somebody’s neighbor, and sometimes it seems he wants to say something. He fears light and holy water. The black mark on his forehead is new: the dead under Prontera used to lie peacefully.
Зомби медленный. Но у него есть вся вечн: Zombies are slow. But they have all of eternity.
Стрелок без стрелы в сердце: Archer Without an Arrow in the Heart
Скелет-лучник из пещер Пайона. Кожи нет,: An Archer Skeleton from the caves of Payon. No skin, no muscles, yet it draws a bow as well as the living. Its quiver is always full — where it gets the arrows, no hunter can figure out. It shoots without pity and without malice: the way it was taught in life.
Стреляет метко. Ему больше нечем занятьс: It shoots true. It has nothing better to do.
Огромный жук с панцирем цвета старого зо: A huge bug with a shell the color of old gold. It lives in the culverts under Prontera and drags off anything that jingles and shines: coins, buttons, rings. Magic bounces off its shell like rain off a roof. The guards joke that Prontera’s treasury is smaller than its nest.
Сколько у жука золота, не знает никто. К: Nobody knows how much gold the bug has. Those who counted never came back.
Мастеринг — огромный поринг в маленькой: Mastering is a huge Poring in a tiny crown. He rules all the Porings of the fields and acts like a king: loud, pompous and dim. He was never a villain. The Grey Hood told him to “bring everything that jingles” — and Mastering did: he swallowed the bell from the Two Bells, and Greta along with it, who was chasing him with her frying pan. Greta later recalled her three hours in the jelly without fondness. The crown was never found after the fight.
Мастеринг — не злодей. Просто корона дав: Mastering isn’t a villain. The crown just squeezes his brain.
Герой орков — легенда деревни орков у Ге: The Orc Hero is the legend of the Orc Village near Geffen. Tall as a house, in a horned helm, with an axe that can split cliffs. Orcs sing of him around their fires, and Geffen folk scare naughty children with him. When he strikes the ground with his axe, the whole forest shudders. He doesn’t seek gold and takes no prisoners: he wants a worthy opponent. They say he respects only those who didn’t back down before his roar — and kills them on the spot.
Герой орков не прощает трусов. Смелых —: The Orc Hero doesn’t forgive cowards. Or the brave.
Козёл с косой в лабиринте: The Goat with a Scythe in the Labyrinth
Бафомет — демон с головой козла, крыльям: Baphomet is a goat-headed demon with wings and a crescent scythe. He is master of the Labyrinth Forest right by Prontera: whoever enters without a map wanders in circles until they come out at his clearing. His retinue is made of Baphomet Jr.s — horned, cheeky and very bouncy. Prontera’s priests argue whether he’s a demon at all or an ancient god people forgot to pray to. Baphomet takes no part in the debate. He just waits in his clearing.
В Лабиринтном лесу все дороги ведут к Ба: In the Labyrinth Forest, all roads lead to Baphomet. Even the way back.
Башня испытаний помнит всех, кого когда-: The Trial Tower remembers everyone Midgard has ever feared and repeats them on its floors. The Tower’s Dark Lord is one such reflection: a skeleton in a night-colored cloak, with a crown on its skull and fire in its eye sockets. It calls down meteors and raises the dead in ranks. The true master of fallen Glast Heim waits in the castle churchyard. They say the reflection laughs just like him.
Корона не делает его королём. Королём ег: The crown doesn’t make him king. The dead who rise at his call do.
Дрейк — капитан затонувшего корабля. Саб: Drake is the captain of the Sunken Ship. Saber, tricorn and a face that should have been buried long ago. His crew still serves — skeletons don’t break contracts. Sailors of Alberta and Izlude cross themselves when sailing over the spot where his ship lies: on a quiet night, laughter and cannon fire rise from the depths. Drake loves gold, rum and fine speeches. Most of all — fine speeches about himself.
Дрейк платит команде вечностью. Никто ещ: Drake pays his crew in eternity. No one has quit yet.
Кролик, который видел затмение: The Rabbit Who Saw the Eclipse
Эклипс — огромный Люнатик с тёмными пятн: Eclipse is a huge Lunatic with dark spots on its fur. They say on the night of the eclipse the moon fell on its back and left marks. Since then it doesn’t hide in its burrow — it goes hunting itself and leaps higher than the trees. Smaller rabbits follow it like a retinue.
Большой кролик — не милый кролик. Спроси: A big rabbit is not a cute rabbit. Ask the ones it jumped on.
Мистресс — королева пчёл из гор Мьёльнир: Mistress is the queen bee of Mt. Mjolnir. Golden wings, a stinger as long as a spear and the temper of a housewife who keeps everything in its place. She rules a hive where every bee would die for her. The honey from her hive is the sweetest in Midgard, but only madmen and very fast thieves collect it. She doesn’t like guests, especially those who come empty-handed and leave with full hands.
Мистресс не кричит. Мистресс жужжит — и: Mistress doesn’t shout. Mistress buzzes — and the whole hive is already here.
Лунный цветок — лиса-оборотень в облике: Moonlight Flower is a fox shapeshifter in the guise of a girl, with a little bell and nine tails. She lives deep in Payon Cave and adores cruel pranks: she leads travelers in circles, swaps their torches and cackles from the dark. Her bell rings sweetly, but whoever hears it in the cave is already too late to run. Her power lies in moonlight, her mood in whim. Payon folk leave rice cakes for her at the entrance: just in case.
Не ходи на звон колокольчика в пещере. О: Don’t follow the sound of a bell in the cave. Especially if it’s laughing.
Осирис — древний правитель, спящий в сер: Osiris is an ancient ruler sleeping in the heart of the pyramid near Morroc. A golden mask, bandages and a staff with which he commands the mummies. Legend says he ruled the sands when Morroc was still an oasis with three palm trees. He doesn’t like tomb robbers — and no other kind of people ever come to a pyramid. Once awake, Osiris doesn’t seek revenge. He seeks whoever dared to wake him.
Осирис спит тысячу лет. Не стоит будить: Osiris has slept for a thousand years. Don't wake him over one chest.
Вокал — вожак рокеров, самый крупный и с: Vocal is the leader of the Rockers, the biggest and loudest grasshopper in the fields. He doesn't play — he sings, and his song sets enemies' ears ringing and puts a spring in his friends' step. Bards call him “the only musician you can't boo off stage.”
Вокал фальшивит. Сказать ему об этом ник: Vocal sings off-key. Nobody dares to tell him.
Попоринг размером с сарай: A Poporing the Size of a Barn
Однажды попоринг съел слишком много вино: Once a Poporing ate too many grapes. Then even more. Now it's a green, poisonous mountain of jelly that hops so hard the ground cracks. Mastering, they say, is jealous. Where the giant passes, the grass yellows for a week, and Payon's vineyards are stripped bare overnight.
Don't feed the Poporing. Seriously. Never.
Болотный зомби — тот, кто когда-то утону: A Swamp Zombie is someone who drowned in the Cursed Marsh long ago and never found peace. Slime slides off him in sheets, swamp water runs from his mouth. He bites and won't let go. The marsh used to keep its dead at the bottom; ever since the Elder Willow fell ill, the bottom no longer holds them.
Он не злится. Ему просто очень холодно и: He isn't angry. He's just very cold and wet — and has been for years.
Скелет-лучник топей стреляет из-за кочек: The Bog Archer Skeleton shoots from behind tussocks with arrows soaked in swamp venom. Its bones are green with slime, its bow creaks, and its string is braided from waterweed. Nobody knows where it learned to shoot; judging by the scraps of its jacket — in the Prontera guard.
Если стрела зелёная — рану промыть. Если: If the arrow is green — wash the wound. If it smells of swamp — wash it twice.
Болотный кузнечик размером с собаку. Ска: A Swamp Hopper the size of a dog. It leaps from tussock to tussock and splashes everyone with mud when it lands. There's no malice in it — only excitement and endless hunger. Travelers steer clear of the marsh: one jump is enough to coat you head to toe.
Кузнечик прыгает — вы в грязи. Кузнечик: The hopper jumps — you're in the mud. The hopper jumps again — you're in it up to your ears.
Трясинная ива — младшая сестра Древней и: The Mire Willow is the Elder Willow's younger sister. Her roots creep along the bottom of the pools and grab the legs of anyone passing by. She is slow and patient: she holds a traveler until the marsh does the rest.
The willow is in no hurry. The marsh hurries for her.
Утопленник — раздутый водой мешок плоти: The Drowned One is a water-bloated sack of flesh in a torn leather jacket, with red tentacle-weeds sprawling from it in every direction. A scrap of skin still shows the tattoo of the Morroc thieves' guild. It holds the path through the pool and tears into anyone who comes near, frenzied, as if it were still drowning. Perhaps it is.
Он тонет уже год. Злится на каждого, кто: He's been drowning for a year. He hates everyone standing on dry land.
Древняя ива стояла над топями у Пронтеры: The Elder Willow stood over the marshes near Prontera before there was a capital. Her roots held the bog together, and her hollow sheltered herons. Then the willow fell ill: she's always thirsty, and she draws every living thing to her — people, beasts, light. Rotten spores drift from her branches, the drowned rise from the pools. Now she's met in the Trial Tower, on the swamp tier. She isn't a villain. She's just very sick.
Ива не хотела никого держать. Ей просто: The willow never wanted to hold anyone. It just hurt too much to let go.
Костяной зомби — всё, что осталось от со: A Ghoul is all that's left of a soldier from the Glast Heim garrison. The flesh is gone; the bones are held together by old straps and black will. It strikes hard and true, just as it was drilled on the parade ground. Sometimes it stops and salutes the empty air.
It remembers the regulations. Not its own name.
Тёмные жрецы служат в соборе Гласт Хейма: The Dark Priests have served in the Glast Heim cathedral since the night the city fell silent. Their prayers run backwards, and their blessings burn. Vika heard them singing in the corridors — and recognized the tune of a lullaby from the orphanage. Nobody knows which is worse: their curses or their longing.
Они поют колыбельную. Только не для живы: They sing a lullaby. Just not for the living.
Рейдрик — рыцарский доспех, в котором ни: A Raydric is a suit of knight's armor with nobody inside. It walks the halls of Glast Heim, guards doors that no longer exist, and serves a lord who died centuries ago. Its sword is heavy, its shield heavier still. On some Raydrics the squad found the crests of the Prontera guard: Garret's unit, twenty years later.
Внутри рейдрика — пустота. И верность, к: Inside a Raydric — emptiness. And a loyalty with nowhere to go.
Гаргулья — каменная статуя с крыльями, к: A Gargoyle is a winged stone statue that once drove evil from the rooftops of Glast Heim. Now the evil lives inside it. It swoops from the belfry, fast as a gust, shrieking like wind in a chimney. A bell once hung beneath its wings; now the bell is cracked.
Гаргулья охраняет колокольню. Правда, да: The Gargoyle guards the belfry. It just forgot from whom long ago.
Мимик выглядит как сундук с сокровищами,: A Mimic looks like a treasure chest, sitting quietly in a corner. Then it opens its lid — and inside are teeth, a tongue, and no gold at all. The Mimics of Glast Heim are especially greedy: they ate those who came to rob the dead. Bran now knocks on every chest before he opens it.
Если сундук стоит слишком удобно — это н: If a chest sits a little too conveniently — it's not a chest.
Рыцарь бездны — в чёрном доспехе, на чёр: An Abysmal Knight — in black armor, on a black horse, with a sword that chills the very air. Twenty years ago he was Garret's lieutenant. He stayed to hold the bridge when the unit fell, and the Grey Hood told him: “Your captain abandoned you.” He believed it and took the black armor. He holds the bridge to this day. Waiting for the captain to return — so he can ask why.
Он держит мост двадцать лет. Приказа уйт: He's held the bridge for twenty years. No one ever gave the order to leave.
Верховный жрец в серебряной митре стоит: A High Priest in a silver mitre stands at the altar of the Glast Heim cathedral, and dead knights rise at his call. Once he was Father Benedict, head of the orphanage at the Prontera cathedral. Ten years ago, during the plague, he buried forty children with his own hands — among them the little son of Ansgar the squire — and broke. The Grey Hood promised him: “Never another small grave.” He raises the dead, sincerely believing he is saving them. He recognized Vika at first glance and could never bring himself to strike her with full strength. He died asking forgiveness. Vika forgave him.
He wanted children to stop dying. So he stopped letting them sleep.
Мумия бредёт по коридорам пирамиды, воло: A Mummy shuffles through the pyramid's corridors, trailing unwound bandages. Once these were the Pharaoh's servants, who agreed to go into the tomb with him. A Mummy passes its curse to anyone it touches: arms grow heavy, legs bog down.
Мумия — это верность, завёрнутая в пятьд: A Mummy is loyalty wrapped in fifty meters of linen.
Скорпион пустыни Сограт — быстрый, злой: The Scorpion of the Sograt Desert — fast, vicious and always hungry. It hides under the sand and leaps out when its prey has almost passed. Its sting leaves a venom that numbs the fingers. As a child, Zara caught scorpions on a dare. Dorn didn't, and is proud of it to this day.
Песок шевелится — отойди. Песок не шевел: The sand moves — step back. The sand doesn't move — step back anyway.
Песчаник — дух бури, слепленный из горяч: A Sandman is a storm spirit molded from hot sand. It's slow, but blows sink into it like into a dune. It raises walls of sand and fills your eyes with grit. Morroc's caravan drivers say Sandmen are caravans the desert never let go.
Бить песок бесполезно. Но другого выхода: Hitting sand is pointless. But there's no other way.
Мардук — жрец-колдун в высоком головном: Marduk is a sorcerer-priest in a tall headdress, guarding the secrets of the Sphinx near Morroc. He raises sandstorms and whispers spells in a language no one living remembers. He served the Pharaoh in life — and serves him still.
Мардук знает все тайны пустыни. Делиться: Marduk knows every secret of the desert. He has no intention of sharing.
Верит — мёртвый пёс-страж в погребальных: Verit is a dead guard dog in burial bandages. It was buried with its master to guard the way to the afterlife. It's still guarding. It bites with a snarl and won't let go until the bandages tear — its own or yours.
Верит служит. Даже когда служить уже нек: Verit serves. Even when there's no one left to serve.
Изида — полуженщина-полузмея, жрица пира: Isis is half woman, half serpent, a priestess of the pyramid. She heals her allies with song, blesses the Mummies and hisses at the living. They say her beautiful face is only a mask, with emptiness and sand beneath. Her robe was woven of silk and snakeskin.
Изида поёт красиво. Главное — не слушать: Isis sings beautifully. Just don't listen to the end.
Та, что спит в ложной гробнице: She Who Sleeps in the False Tomb
Древняя мумия — первая жрица пирамиды, п: The Ancient Mummy is the pyramid's first priestess, entombed before Osiris himself. She guards the false tomb so grave robbers will think they've found the Pharaoh. Her bandages are black with age, and her shroud deadens any blow. She was the first one Greta's bell put to sleep.
Она охраняла пустую гробницу три тысячи: She guarded an empty tomb for three thousand years. The bell told her: enough.
Осирис правил песками, когда Моррок был: Osiris ruled the sands when Morroc was an oasis. He died as a pharaoh should: with honors, servants and a faithful hound at the door — and swore to lie in his tomb and never rise. For a thousand years the oath kept him asleep, until the Grey Hood placed a horned mark on the sarcophagus. Now the mark binds him like a chain and forces him to raise the Mummies. He doesn't want power. He wants only one thing — to sleep again. After the battle Osiris thanks the squad, speaks the word “seal” for the first time — and explains whose knot he is. Then he lies back down in the sarcophagus. On his own.
Самый страшный фараон — тот, кому не даю: The most terrible pharaoh is the one who isn't allowed to sleep.
Бонгун — мертвец в синей одежде чиновник: Bongun is a corpse in an official's blue robes and a cap with a talisman on its forehead. He doesn't walk — he hops on stiff legs, as is fitting for those not buried by the rites. Payon's elders say Bongun is searching for his sister Munak and hops toward any woman's voice.
Бонгун прыгает к вам не со зла. Он прост: Bongun isn't hopping at you out of malice. He just can't stop.
Мунэ — мёртвая девушка в красном с жёлты: Munak is a dead girl in red with a yellow talisman on her forehead. The talisman keeps her in this world but lets her neither speak nor cry. She stands in the way and takes blows like a wall — because it's all she knows how to do. The people of Payon leave rice balls at the cave for her and her brother.
Талисман держит её здесь. Кто бы его сня: The talisman holds her here. If only someone would take it off — but there's no one.
Енот с листком на голове: Raccoon with a Leaf on Its Head
Smokie is a sly raccoon from Payon's forests. He puts a leaf on his head and turns into anything at all: a stump, a bush, an old lady, Bran. Only his tail gives him away. He blows smoke and steals food, then hides among his kin — good luck telling which one is real.
Если у Брана вдруг полосатый хвост — это: If Bran suddenly has a striped tail — that's not Bran.
Хоронг — живой огонь из пайонских пещер,: Horong is living fire from the caves of Payon, the spirit of a lantern someone forgot to put out. It flies through the dark and spits foxfire. This spring the Horongs speak with the voices of the dead and lure travelers into the thicket. Bran followed one for a whole minute.
Огонёк в лесу ведёт домой. Только не к в: A light in the forest leads home. Just not to your home.
Сохи — призрак девушки в белом свадебном: Sohee is the ghost of a girl in a white wedding dress. She was left waiting at the altar, and she waits still, her face hidden behind long hair. She weeps — and her weeping closes her allies' wounds and chills the hearts of the living. Sohee hates no one. She's just very sad.
Сохи плачет не над вами. Но вам всё равн: Sohee isn't weeping over you. But you go cold all the same.
Девятихвостая — старая лиса Пайона, прож: Nine Tail is an old fox of Payon who has lived so long she grew nine tails. One look from her can charm a warrior into lowering his sword and smiling. Nine Tails are the children of Moonlight Flower, and few of them remain in her burned forest.
Не смотри лисе в глаза. Уже посмотрел? Т: Don't look the fox in the eye. Already did? Then grip your sword tighter.
Настоятель Мунэ — самый старый из прыгаю: The Abbot Munak is the oldest of the hopping dead, once the keeper of an abandoned temple near Payon. He slaps talismans on everyone who passes, and they freeze in place. The villagers walked past his temple “as if in a dream,” and he didn't touch a single one: on his talisman the squad found a black mark.
Настоятель опечатывает всё подряд. Даже: The Abbot seals everything in sight. Even silence.
Лунный цветок — хранительница пайонского: Moonlight Flower is the guardian of Payon Forest, a fox spirit in the form of a girl. Once she played tricks on travelers, led them in circles and laughed from the dark, and at night she sang the dead in the cave a lullaby: “sleep.” Ten years ago a fire swept the forest, and her kits burned in their dens. The Grey Hood promised to bring them back, and she accepted the horned mark herself — no one forced her. Now her lullaby sings not “sleep” but “come to me,” in the voices of the dead, and people leave the village at night. This isn't cruelty. It's grief that has found itself an excuse.
Она поёт колыбельную для лисят. Лисята н: She sings a lullaby for her kits. The kits don't hear it. Everyone else does.
Скелет-пират — моряк с корабля Дрейка. Т: The Pirate Skeleton is a sailor from Drake's ship. His tricorn has grown into his skull, his saber has rusted, but it still cuts just as well. He sings sea shanties no one on land remembers and fights as if he's still being paid.
The pirate is dead. Piracy isn't.
Сворд-фиш — рыба с носом длиной с меч. К: The Swordfish is a fish with a nose as long as a sword. Schools of Swordfish guard the approaches to the sunken ship and skewer anyone who swims too slowly. Izlude's fishermen sell their noses as souvenir rapiers.
A fish with a sword. The sea loves a joke.
Марс — синий кальмар, который бьёт струё: Marse is a blue squid that fires a jet of water hard enough to knock you off your feet. It keeps its distance and puffs indignantly if you come close. After a shot it has to take in more water, and in that moment it's very vulnerable.
Марс стреляет водой. На суше это было бы: Marse shoots water. On land that would be funny.
Обеон — русалка с серой кожей и тёмными: Obeaune is a mermaid with grey skin and dark eyes. When she sings, her allies feel lighter and the living find it harder to think. Izlude's sailors plug their ears with wax, but wax doesn't always help. They say the Obeaunes remember everyone who drowned in these waters.
Обеоны поют о тех, кто не вернулся домой: The Obeaunes sing of those who never came home. They have many songs.
Кукре — морской рачок, у которого панцир: Kukre is a little sea crustacean with a shell sturdier than a wall. It crawls along the ship's hull, collecting scraps, and shuts itself off from any blow. Slow and stubborn, like an old bosun.
Кукре не нападает. Кукре просто не уходи: Kukre doesn't attack. Kukre just doesn't leave.
Гидра — клубок щупалец с пастью в середи: The Hydra is a knot of tentacles with a maw in the middle. It lives in flooded holds and grabs anything that floats past. Cut off one tentacle — two more are already reaching for you. Drake's sailors fed it their scraps; now it feeds itself.
У Гидры нет головы. Зато рук — на весь о: The Hydra has no head. But it has enough arms for the whole squad.
Боцман-призрак служил Дрейку сто лет наз: The Ghost Bosun served Drake a hundred years ago and serves him still: so the contract says, and not even death breaks a contract with Drake. He blows his whistle — and the dead crew springs to their posts. He fights with an anchor. He's no less tired than the captain, but complaining isn't done on board.
«Все наверх!» — кричит боцман. Наверху у: “All hands on deck!” the bosun shouts. The deck has been underwater for ages.
Сто лет назад капитан Дрейк поклялся бра: A hundred years ago Captain Drake swore to the brother of Helmut the bell-ringer never to give up his cargo — the bell-ringer's coffin — and took eternal life as payment. The ship sank off Izlude, but Drake didn't die. He couldn't. Then the Grey Hood placed a horned mark on him, and Drake forgot what he was guarding: he remembers only “give it to no one” and sinks everything that sails past. He jokes, swaggers, fires ghostly cannons and drinks rum that lost its taste long ago. At the end of the battle Drake asks Greta to ring her bell — for him too. And falls asleep with a smile. The coffin in the hold is still there.
Вечная жизнь — это долго. Особенно под в: Eternal life is a long time. Especially underwater and without rum.
Дуллахан — рыцарь без головы на призрачн: Dullahan is a headless knight on a ghostly steed. He carries his head under his arm, and it looks around, naming those whose time has come. In his hands is a scythe, ghostly and sharp. They say he knocks on the doors of those whose hour has come. In Niflheim he's just doing his job.
Дуллахан не видит вас. Его голова — види: Dullahan can't see you. His head can.
A Banshee is the ghost of a woman in a tattered shroud. Her wail tears at the soul, and a warrior who hears it up close forgets where he was going. Banshees scream for those who are about to die. In Niflheim they never stop screaming.
Если банши молчит — значит, вы уже на ме: If the Banshee is silent — it means you've already arrived.
Гиббет — мёртвое дерево, на ветвях котор: Gibbet is a dead tree with cages and nooses swinging from its branches. It roams Niflheim, gathering those who stopped to rest. The nooses come alive on their own. Sometimes a whisper drifts from the cages.
Гиббет не спешит. Рано или поздно все пр: Gibbet's in no hurry. Sooner or later, everyone sits down.
Квив — маленький дух в колпаке, который: Quve is a little spirit in a pointed cap who dances among the dead and cheers them on. His dance closes the wounds of the dead and makes the living dizzy. He's cheerful. In Niflheim, that's the most frightening thing of all.
Квив танцует на кладбище. Музыка у него: Quve dances in the graveyard. He brings his own music.
Кровавый убийца — высокий мертвец в плащ: The Bloody Murderer is a tall dead man in a cloak and mask, with a knife that never dries. He steps out of the fog behind you, strikes and vanishes. In life, they say, he was an executioner — and Niflheim found him his old job.
В тумане Нифльхейма не оборачивайся. Он: Don't look back in Niflheim's fog. He's already behind you anyway.
Лоли Рури — вампирша с внешностью девочк: Loli Ruri is a vampire who looks like a little girl, in a black dress, with a huge cross-shaped pillow. She is several centuries old, capricious and polite. She invites guests to dinner, and the dinner turns out to be them. Her kiss drinks blood, and the feast fills her with power.
Лоли Рури всегда рада гостям. Особенно т: Loli Ruri is always happy to have guests. Especially warm ones.
Мост Гьёлль, золотой и узкий, как лезвие: Gyoll Bridge, golden and narrow as a blade, leads into the heart of Niflheim. The Warden has stood on it since the dawn of time, collecting a toll: no passage for the living, no way back for the dead. From the squad he demanded one thing — to leave the veteran behind, “he's half ours already.” This time Captain Garret walked beside them, not in front.
Пошлина на мосту одна: кого-то из вас. В: The bridge toll is one of you. Choose for yourselves.
Тёмный лорд — демон, генерал Сатаны Морр: The Dark Lord is a demon, a general of Satan Morroc and master of fallen Glast Heim. They say the lord of the castle made a pact with him for power and opened the night watch — by morning, no one in the city was left alive. The Lord doesn't want to rule the living: he wants the gates of Niflheim open and an army of the dead upon his master's seal. He loves to recall that night and to mock those who retreated. Twenty years ago Captain Garret carried a wounded squire away from his gates, and the Lord calls it the finest gift of his long life. Defeated, he laughs: he's only the gatekeeper, and the key has long been with the horned one in the forest.
Он помнит, как гасли окна Гласт Хейма. О: He remembers the windows of Glast Heim going dark. One after another.
Владыка мёртвых — не демон, а управитель: The Lord of Death is no demon but Hel's steward: an armored rider on a ghostly steed, with a scythe he uses not to reap but to point the way. He watches over the goddess's subjects and for centuries has seen them freeze in the fog. The Dark Lord promised him a living world with sunlight for the dead, and the Lord of Death led his army to the open gates — as if to a festival. Hel was silent, so he decided for himself. He was defeated not by a sword but by the changing of the guard: the ring of a bell reminded the dead that they were meant to sleep. He fell asleep first.
Он вёл мёртвых к солнцу. Он не знал, что: He led the dead toward the sun. He didn't know the sun was a fire.
Жук-вор — хозяин стоков под Пронтерой. О: The Thief Bug is master of the sewers beneath Prontera. It drags everything shiny back to its nest: coins, buckles, nails, silver spoons. If a spoon goes missing in the capital, look for it here, under three layers of bugs. Its bite hurts, but it most likes to bite at your pocket: look away for a second — and your belt buckle is gone.
В Пронтере говорят: «Уронил — значит, по: In Prontera they say: “Dropped it? Then you gave it to the bugs.”
Кладка в кирпичной стене: A Clutch in the Brick Wall
Яйца жуков-воров лежат рядами в тёплых н: Thief Bug Eggs lie in rows in the warm niches of the sewer brickwork, like coins in a purse.
